name: FlyToUIEffect
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "reward fly" feedback — the classic mobile-game "coins arc from a pickup toward the wallet icon, then vanish" effect. Answers the obvious performance question up front, two ways: 1) Pools icon instances via the EXISTING Toolkit.Core.ObjectPool instead of Instantiate/Destroy — repeated bursts over time reuse already-arrived instances instead of churning fresh GameObjects. 2) SpawnBurst caps how many icons are EVER visually spawned for one burst (maxVisualIcons) — a "500 coins" reward doesn't need 500 live objects on screen at once; cap the visual count and let a counter absorb the rest (add up the actual amount yourself in OnBurstComplete/OnIconArrived). Pooling alone can't reduce PEAK CONCURRENT instances for one genuinely simultaneous burst — only the visual cap can.

src_serialized.name: iconPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: The icon spawned per flying item (e.g. a coin Image), as a prefab or scene template. A CanvasGroup is added automatically if missing, for the fade-out.

src_serialized.name: burstStagger
src_serialized.tooltip: Delay between each icon's launch within a burst, in seconds.

src_serialized.name: scatterRadius
src_serialized.tooltip: Random scatter radius applied to each icon's start position before it arcs to the target — 0 disables scatter.

src_serialized.name: arcHeight
src_serialized.tooltip: How high the arc bulges above a straight line to the target, in UI units.

src_serialized.name: defaultMaxVisualIcons
src_serialized.tooltip: Hard cap on how many icons a single SpawnBurst call will ever create, regardless of the requested count.

src_members.name: PendingInBurst
src_members.comment: How many icons are still in flight from the most recent SpawnBurst — set synchronously the moment SpawnBurst is called (before any staggered coroutine actually runs), so it's a reliable way to confirm the visual cap took effect immediately, without needing to wait for icons to arrive.

src_members.name: Spawn
src_members.comment: startScreenPosition/target are resolved via screen space, so either UI or world-space origins work — see SpawnBurstFromWorld for a world-position convenience overload.

src_members.sig: public void SpawnBurst(Vector2 startScreenPosition, RectTransform target, int logicalCount, int maxVisualIcons = -1)
src_members.name: SpawnBurst
src_members.comment: Spawns min(logicalCount, maxVisualIcons) icons from the same start position, staggered, all converging on target — pass the real reward amount as logicalCount even for huge rewards; only the capped visual count actually gets instantiated. maxVisualIcons <= 0 uses defaultMaxVisualIcons.
